parameters.query:
select public.promote_contact_to_lead(
         $1::uuid, $2::uuid, nullif($3, '')::uuid,
         jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
           'email',        nullif($4, ''),
           'first_name',   nullif($5, ''),
           'last_name',    nullif($6, ''),
           'job_title',    nullif($7, ''),
           'company_name', nullif($8, ''),
           'website',      nullif($9, ''),
           'phone_number', nullif($10, ''),
           'phone_source', nullif($11, ''),
           'qualification', nullif($12, '')
         ))) as result;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ String($('[S] Set last_reply (LATEST by date_received DESC)').first().json.last_reply.data[0].campaign_id), $('[S] Resolve client sequencer').first().json.client_sequencer_id ] }}

parameters.query:
select c.id::text as campaign_id
from public.campaigns c
join public.client_sequencers cs on cs.client_id = c.client_id and cs.id = $2::uuid
where c.external_id = $1
limit 1;

select cs.id::text as client_sequencer_id, cs.client_id::text as client_id
from public.client_sequencers cs
join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'emailbison'
where cs.external_workspace_id = $1 and cs.enabled
limit 1;

parameters.query: select public.upsert_sequencer_contact($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, null, null)::text as sequencer_contact_id;

-- ADR-0012: per-client Bison credentials live in client_sequencers, never in a spreadsheet.
-- This is what lets every Bison call below survive the Google Sheets cutover.
select cs.id::text          as client_sequencer_id,
       cs.client_id::text   as client_id,
       cs.api_key           as bison_api_key,
       cs.external_workspace_id as workspace_id,
       c.name               as client_name
from public.client_sequencers cs
join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'emailbison'
join public.clients    c on c.id = cs.client_id
where cs.external_workspace_id = $1 and cs.enabled and coalesce(cs.api_key, '') <> ''
limit 1;
